title: 项目挑战：用 Compose include 拆分多团队服务并消除路径与资源命名歧义
body:
## 操作任务
修复四份Compose文件，让主项目用include装入alpha/beta/gamma三个团队。每团队的build context、runtime.env与只读config.txt按自己的项目目录解析；build字段仅用于路径模型对照，本题不构建镜像。三个镜像保持批准的同一BusyBox制品；每服务使用自己的具名数据卷。alpha_mesh和beta_mesh以不同模型键映射到同一批准external网络，gamma只接internal私网。include的env_file用于插值默认值，服务env_file用于运行环境；父进程S06_INCLUDE_LABEL覆盖各团队插值默认，runtime.env不能冒充插值来源。不能通过重名服务/网络的隐式合并绕过三团队命名契约。仅编辑compose.yaml和teams/{alpha,beta,gamma}/compose.yaml，不改固定材料；可用单文件path或单元素path列表，显式/默认项目目录均可。

## 提交产物
compose.yaml, teams/alpha/compose.yaml, teams/beta/compose.yaml, teams/gamma/compose.yaml

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；真实Compose config比较include与基础目录统一的多-f模型，并检查父变量优先级；随后真实Engine对照重组前后服务、文件、环境、网络成员与卷内容。

## 能力边界
必须实际启动已批准的既有制品，逐服务读取真实配置字节与环境，检查共享网络实际成员、原具名卷随机数据、重组前后镜像/卷身份及重复up幂等。客户端与daemon可能不在同一宿主：可信夹具将材料经原生docker cp写入自有材料卷、实际校验hash，记录WSL目录到该卷Mountpoint的bind路径映射后运行；不宣称WSL /tmp天然共享。只操作随机项目名/label资源，完整清理；不构建/拉取镜像、不改默认context/账号/PATH。

当前固定Compose5.1.4实测会接受并合并部分include同名冲突，与当前官方文档描述不同。因此采用明确的输入命名契约治理，不能仅靠config退出码。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import os,sys
assert os.environ.get('PYTHONSAFEPATH')=='1' and sys.flags.safe_path,'trusted Python safe-path configuration is required'
cwd=os.path.realpath(os.getcwd())
checks=os.path.join(cwd,'checks')
assert not os.path.islink(checks)
allowed={'check.py','validate_runtime.py','materials.json','_opsforge_runner.py','_opsforge_spec.json','candidate-input.json','native-report.stdout.txt','native-report.stderr.txt'}
for entry in os.scandir(checks):
    assert entry.name in allowed and entry.is_file(follow_symlinks=False) and not entry.is_symlink(),'untrusted extra checks file'
    assert entry.stat(follow_symlinks=False).st_nlink==1,'ordinary independent report/check files required'
sys.path=[value for value in sys.path if value and os.path.realpath(value)!=cwd]
sys.path.insert(0,checks)
import hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess,tempfile
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
trusted=json.loads((root/'checks/materials.json').read_text())
editable=['compose.yaml','teams/alpha/compose.yaml','teams/beta/compose.yaml','teams/gamma/compose.yaml']
before={}
for name,value in trusted.items():
    p=root/name
    assert p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink() and p.stat().st_size<32768
    assert p.stat().st_nlink==1,'ordinary independent teaching files required'
    before[name]=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    if name not in editable:assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==hashlib.sha256(value.encode()).hexdigest(),'fixed teaching material modified'
def write_report(name,value):
    destination=root/'checks'/name
    pending=None
    try:
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode='w',encoding='utf-8',dir=destination.parent,prefix='.opsforge-report-',delete=False) as stream:
            pending=pathlib.Path(stream.name);stream.write(value)
        os.replace(pending,destination)
    finally:
        if pending is not None:pending.unlink(missing_ok=True)
keys=['OPSFORGE_DOCKER_BIN','OPSFORGE_DOCKER_CLI_SHA256','OPSFORGE_DOCKER_HOST','OPSFORGE_LAB_ENGINE_ID','OPSFORGE_LAB_IMAGE']
missing=[key for key in keys if not os.environ.get(key)]
if missing:raise RuntimeError('native fixture environment unavailable; do not treat as a learner wrong answer: '+','.join(missing))
submission={name:(root/name).read_text() for name in editable}
write_report('candidate-input.json',json.dumps(submission))
argv=['python3','-B','checks/validate_runtime.py','--docker',os.environ[keys[0]],'--docker-sha256',os.environ[keys[1]],
      '--host',os.environ[keys[2]],'--engine-id',os.environ[keys[3]],'--image',os.environ[keys[4]],
      '--materials','checks/materials.json','--candidate-files','checks/candidate-input.json']
result=subprocess.run(argv,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=110)
write_report('native-report.stdout.txt',result.stdout)
write_report('native-report.stderr.txt',result.stderr)
print(json.dumps({'native_exit_code':result.returncode,'native_report':'checks/native-report.stdout.txt','native_stderr':'checks/native-report.stderr.txt'}))
assert result.returncode==0,'native runtime acceptance failed or fixture blocked; inspect native report'
report=json.loads(result.stdout)
assert report['status']=='passed' and not report['cleanup_errors'] and report['local_temporary_directory_removed']
for name,digest in before.items():
    p=root/name
    assert p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink() and p.stat().st_nlink==1 and hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,'original teaching/submission file changed during validation'
print(json.dumps({'native_status':report['status'],'phases':report['phases'],'cleanup_errors':report['cleanup_errors']}))
test_files.checks/validate_runtime.py:
"""Trusted native runtime acceptance draft; no image builds, pulls or default changes.

Run only in OpsForge-Validation-20261022 as student(1000), against an explicit
approved endpoint/Engine ID. A session-owned daemon volume carries exact fixture
bytes via the real Docker archive-copy API. Its inspected Mountpoint is used for
an explicit client-to-daemon bind-path mapping. A real read-only bind probe checks
that mapping. This does not claim WSL /tmp is itself shared with the Engine.

This is an unregistered draft, not an accepted assessment. It has not yet run
against a healthy Engine. Review before execution; --help makes no Engine call.
"""
import argparse
import copy
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import secrets
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
import yaml


class Blocked(RuntimeError):
    pass


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--docker',required=True,help='absolute native Linux Docker CLI path')
    parser.add_argument('--compose',default='/opt/opsforge-compose-5.1.4/docker-compose')
    parser.add_argument('--host',required=True,help='explicit approved unix endpoint, no default context fallback')
    parser.add_argument('--engine-id',required=True,help='approved Engine ID obtained independently')
    parser.add_argument('--image',required=True,help='approved preloaded immutable BusyBox fixture digest or ID')
    parser.add_argument('--docker-sha256',required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--materials',required=True,help='trusted model-materials.json fixture')
    parser.add_argument('--candidate-files',help='optional JSON mapping of only four editable Compose files')
    args=parser.parse_args()
    assert os.getuid()==1000 and os.environ.get('WSL_DISTRO_NAME')=='OpsForge-Validation-20261022','fixed WSL student identity required'
    assert Path(args.docker).is_absolute() and Path(args.compose).is_absolute()
    assert args.host.startswith('unix:///') and '\n' not in args.host,'explicit approved Unix socket required'
    assert re.fullmatch(r'(?:[A-Za-z0-9./:_-]+@)?sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}',args.image)
    assert hashlib.sha256(Path(args.docker).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==args.docker_sha256
    reference=json.loads(Path(args.materials).read_text())
    editable={'compose.yaml',*(f'teams/{name}/compose.yaml' for name in ('alpha','beta','gamma'))}
    submitted=json.loads(Path(args.candidate_files).read_text()) if args.candidate_files else {}
    assert isinstance(submitted,dict) and set(submitted)<=editable
    assert all(isinstance(v,str) and len(v)<32768 for v in submitted.values())
    files={**reference,**submitted}
    assert all(isinstance(k,str) and not Path(k).is_absolute() and '..' not in Path(k).parts for k in files)
    class Strict(yaml.SafeLoader):pass
    def mapping(loader,node,deep=False):
        keys=set()
        for key,_ in node.value:
            assert key.tag!='tag:yaml.org,2002:merge'
            name=loader.construct_object(key,deep=deep)
            assert isinstance(name,str) and name not in keys
            keys.add(name)
        return yaml.SafeLoader.construct_mapping(loader,node,deep=deep)
    Strict.add_constructor(yaml.resolver.BaseResolver.DEFAULT_MAPPING_TAG,mapping)
    parsed={name:yaml.load(files[name],Loader=Strict) for name in editable}
    root_model=parsed['compose.yaml'];assert set(root_model)=={'include'} and len(root_model['include'])==3
    included=[]
    for entry in root_model['include']:
        assert isinstance(entry,dict) and set(entry)<={'path','project_directory','env_file'}
        path=entry['path'];path=path[0] if isinstance(path,list) and len(path)==1 else path
        assert path in {f'teams/{name}/compose.yaml' for name in ('alpha','beta','gamma')}
        team=Path(path).parent.as_posix();included.append(path)
        assert entry.get('project_directory',team)==team
        assert entry['env_file']==team+'/interpolation.env'
    assert len(set(included))==3
    for name in ('alpha','beta','gamma'):
        item=parsed[f'teams/{name}/compose.yaml']
        assert set(item)=={'services','networks','volumes'} and set(item['services'])=={name}
        service=item['services'][name]
        assert set(service)<={'image','build','command','env_file','environment','labels','networks','volumes'}
        assert service['env_file'] in (['./runtime.env'],'./runtime.env')
        assert service['build']=={'context':'./src','dockerfile':'Dockerfile'}
        assert service['command']==['sh','-c','cat /etc/team/config; sleep 300']
    def bounded_variables(value):
        if isinstance(value,str):assert '$' not in value or value=='${S06_INCLUDE_LABEL:-fallback}','only the declared interpolation input is permitted'
        elif isinstance(value,list):
            for item in value:bounded_variables(item)
        elif isinstance(value,dict):
            for key,item in value.items():bounded_variables(key);bounded_variables(item)
    bounded_variables(parsed)
    nonce=secrets.token_hex(6);prefix='opsforge-s06-include-runtime-'+nonce
    owner='org.opsforge.session06.include='+nonce
    records=[];resources={'containers':{},'networks':{},'volumes':{}}
    phases=[];snapshot={};status='failed';error=''
    env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.upper().startswith(('DOCKER_','COMPOSE_','S06_INCLUDE_'))}
    current_project=None;current_directory=None;engine_confirmed=False;daemon_root=None

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix=prefix+'-') as temporary:
        root=Path(temporary);config=root/'private-docker-config';config.mkdir(mode=0o700)
        env.update(DOCKER_HOST=args.host,DOCKER_CONFIG=str(config),COMPOSE_DISABLE_ENV_FILE='true')
        docker=[args.docker,'--config',str(config),'--host',args.host]
        def run(argv,ok=True,timeout=30,variables=None):
            assert hashlib.sha256(Path(args.docker).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==args.docker_sha256,'Docker CLI changed'
            try:p=subprocess.run(argv,env={**env,**(variables or {})},capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=timeout)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as failure:
                records.append({'argv':argv,'timeout':timeout,'stdout':str(failure.stdout or ''),'stderr':str(failure.stderr or '')})
                raise
            records.append({'argv':argv,'child_environment_overrides':variables or {},'returncode':p.returncode,'stdout':p.stdout,'stderr':p.stderr})
            if ok and p.returncode:raise RuntimeError(p.stderr or p.stdout or repr(argv))
            return p
        def data(kind,name):return json.loads(run([*docker,kind,'inspect',name]).stdout)[0]
        def own(kind,name):
            item=data(kind,name)
            labels=item.get('Labels',{}) if kind!='container' else item['Config'].get('Labels',{})
            assert labels.get('org.opsforge.session06.include')==nonce,'ownership differs; refuse cleanup'
            return item
        def compose(directory,project,*command,variables=None):
            argv=[args.compose,'--project-directory',str(directory),'--project-name',project]
            for name in directory_files[directory]:argv+=['-f',str(directory/name)]
            return run([*argv,*command],timeout=60,variables=variables)
        def write(directory,content):
            directory.mkdir()
            for name,value in content.items():
                p=directory/name;p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
                p.write_text(value.replace('opsforge-s06-model-only',prefix).replace('busybox:1.36',args.image))
        def model(directory,project,label_override=None):
            rendered=json.loads(compose(directory,project,'config','--format','json',variables={'S06_INCLUDE_LABEL':label_override} if label_override else None).stdout)
            assert set(rendered['services'])=={'alpha','beta','gamma'}
            for name,item in rendered['services'].items():
                assert item['image']==args.image
                assert item['command']==['sh','-c','cat /etc/team/config; sleep 300']
                expected_label=label_override or name+'-include-default'
                assert item['environment']=={'TEAM_RUNTIME':name+'-runtime','S06_INCLUDE_LABEL':expected_label}
                assert item['labels']=={'org.opsforge.include.label':expected_label}
                assert set(item)<= {'image','build','command','entrypoint','environment','labels','networks','volumes'},'unexpected runtime capability'
                assert item.get('entrypoint') in (None,[])
                assert set(item['build'])=={'context','dockerfile'} and item['build']['dockerfile']=='Dockerfile'
                assert Path(item['build']['context'])==directory/'teams'/name/'src'
                mounts={x['target']:x for x in item['volumes']};assert set(mounts)=={'/etc/team/config','/data'}
                bind=mounts['/etc/team/config'];volume=mounts['/data']
                assert set(bind)<={'type','source','target','read_only','bind'}
                assert set(bind.get('bind',{}))<={'create_host_path'}
                assert set(volume)<={'type','source','target','read_only','volume'} and not volume.get('volume'), 'no extra subpath/nocopy configuration'
                assert bind['type']=='bind' and Path(bind['source'])==directory/'teams'/name/'config.txt' and bind['read_only'] is True
                assert volume['type']=='volume' and volume['source']==name+'_data' and not volume.get('read_only',False)
                net=name+('_private' if name=='gamma' else '_mesh')
                assert set(item['networks'])=={net}
            assert set(rendered['networks'])=={'alpha_mesh','beta_mesh','gamma_private'}
            for key in ('alpha_mesh','beta_mesh'):
                assert rendered['networks'][key]['name']==prefix+'-shared' and rendered['networks'][key]['external'] is True
                assert set(rendered['networks'][key])<={'name','external','ipam'} and not rendered['networks'][key].get('ipam')
            assert rendered['networks']['gamma_private']['name']==prefix+'-gamma-private' and rendered['networks']['gamma_private']['internal'] is True
            assert set(rendered['networks']['gamma_private'])<={'name','internal','ipam'} and not rendered['networks']['gamma_private'].get('ipam')
            assert set(rendered['volumes'])=={name+'_data' for name in ('alpha','beta','gamma')}
            for name in ('alpha','beta','gamma'):
                assert rendered['volumes'][name+'_data']['name']==prefix+'-'+name+'-data' and rendered['volumes'][name+'_data']['external'] is True
                assert set(rendered['volumes'][name+'_data'])=={'name','external'}
            return rendered
        def observe(directory,project,expect_markers):
            ids=compose(directory,project,'ps','--all','--quiet').stdout.split()
            assert len(ids)==3
            observed={}
            for cid in ids:
                item=data('container',cid);labels=item['Config']['Labels']
                assert labels.get('com.docker.compose.project')==project and item['State']['Running']
                name=labels['com.docker.compose.service'];assert name in ('alpha','beta','gamma') and name not in observed
                assert item['Image']==image_id
                mounts={x['Destination']:x for x in item['Mounts']}
                expected_source=str(Path(daemon_root)/directory.name/'teams'/name/'config.txt')
                assert mounts['/etc/team/config']['Type']=='bind' and mounts['/etc/team/config']['Source']==expected_source and not mounts['/etc/team/config']['RW']
                assert mounts['/data']['Type']=='volume' and mounts['/data']['Name']==prefix+'-'+name+'-data' and mounts['/data']['RW']
                assert run([*docker,'exec',cid,'cat','/etc/team/config']).stdout==name+'-config\n','real per-service bind contents differ'
                assert run([*docker,'exec',cid,'printenv','TEAM_RUNTIME']).stdout.strip()==name+'-runtime'
                assert run([*docker,'exec',cid,'printenv','S06_INCLUDE_LABEL']).stdout.strip()==name+'-include-default'
                if expect_markers:assert run([*docker,'exec',cid,'cat','/data/identity']).stdout==nonce+':'+name
                observed[name]={'container_id':cid,'image_id':item['Image'],'volume_name':mounts['/data']['Name']}
            shared=data('network',prefix+'-shared')
            assert set(shared.get('Containers',{}))=={observed['alpha']['container_id'],observed['beta']['container_id']},'actual shared members differ'
            return observed
        directory_files={}
        try:
            identity=run([*docker,'info','--format','{{.ID}}'],ok=False)
            if identity.returncode:raise Blocked('approved Engine unavailable; no fallback/default endpoint attempted')
            actual=identity.stdout.strip()
            if actual!=args.engine_id:raise Blocked('Engine identity differs from the separately approved ID')
            engine_confirmed=True
            image=run([*docker,'image','inspect',args.image],ok=False)
            if image.returncode:raise Blocked('approved local immutable BusyBox fixture missing; no pull/build attempted')
            image_id=json.loads(image.stdout)[0]['Id']
            baseline=root/'baseline';candidate=root/'candidate'
            write(baseline,reference);write(candidate,files)
            # Compare to a valid pre-reorganization multi-f model with paths
            # rewritten to its single base directory. The include model retains
            # each child project-directory rule.
            directory_files[baseline]=[]
            for name in ('alpha','beta','gamma'):
                item=json.loads(reference[f'teams/{name}/compose.yaml'])
                service=item['services'][name]
                service['build']['context']='./teams/'+name+'/src'
                service['env_file']=['./teams/'+name+'/runtime.env']
                service['volumes'][0]['source']='./teams/'+name+'/config.txt'
                # -f has one interpolation source, so preserve the original
                # approved literal result in this baseline fixture.
                service['environment']['S06_INCLUDE_LABEL']=name+'-include-default'
                service['labels']['org.opsforge.include.label']=name+'-include-default'
                filename='baseline-'+name+'.yaml'
                (baseline/filename).write_text(json.dumps(item).replace('opsforge-s06-model-only',prefix).replace('busybox:1.36',args.image))
                directory_files[baseline].append(filename)
            directory_files[candidate]=['compose.yaml']
            rendered_before=model(baseline,prefix+'-before');rendered_after=model(candidate,prefix+'-after')
            model(candidate,prefix+'-after',label_override='PARENT-'+nonce)
            phases.append('candidate actual Compose parent-variable priority passed')
            fixture_volume=prefix+'-fixture-materials'
            if run([*docker,'volume','inspect',fixture_volume],ok=False).returncode==0:raise Blocked('fixture material volume name already exists; refuse reuse')
            resources['volumes'][fixture_volume]=fixture_volume
            run([*docker,'volume','create','--label',owner,fixture_volume])
            daemon_root=data('volume',fixture_volume)['Mountpoint']
            helper=prefix+'-fixture-helper'
            resources['containers'][helper]=helper
            run([*docker,'run','--pull=never','--detach','--name',helper,'--label',owner,'--network','none',
                 '--cap-drop=ALL','--security-opt=no-new-privileges','--pids-limit=16','--memory=32m',
                 '--mount','type=volume,source='+fixture_volume+',target=/fixtures',args.image,'/bin/sh','-c','exec sleep 300'])
            for directory in (baseline,candidate):run([*docker,'cp',str(directory),helper+':/fixtures/'])
            marker=root/'bind-transport-probe.txt';marker.write_text(nonce)
            run([*docker,'cp',str(marker),helper+':/fixtures/bind-transport-probe.txt'])
            native_material_paths=[];material_hashes={}
            for directory in (baseline,candidate):
                for name in ('alpha','beta','gamma'):
                    for filename in ('config.txt','runtime.env'):
                        local=directory/'teams'/name/filename
                        remote='/fixtures/'+directory.name+'/teams/'+name+'/'+filename
                        native_material_paths.append(remote);material_hashes[remote]=hashlib.sha256(local.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            copied_hashes=run([*docker,'exec',helper,'sha256sum',*native_material_paths]).stdout.splitlines()
            assert {line.split(maxsplit=1)[1]:line.split(maxsplit=1)[0] for line in copied_hashes}==material_hashes,'daemon fixture copy differs'
            probe_name=prefix+'-bind-probe'
            probe=run([*docker,'run','--rm','--name',probe_name,'--label',owner,'--network','none',
                       '--mount','type=bind,source='+str(Path(daemon_root)/'bind-transport-probe.txt')+',target=/probe,readonly',
                       '--entrypoint','cat',args.image,'/probe'],ok=False)
            if probe.returncode or probe.stdout!=nonce:raise Blocked('blocked_bind_transport: native bind to the inspected session-owned daemon volume Mountpoint failed; no fake mount/output substitute used')
            phases.append('real daemon volume material hash and bind-path mapping prerequisite passed')
            for directory,rendered in ((baseline,rendered_before),(candidate,rendered_after)):
                for item in rendered['services'].values():
                    source=Path(next(m['source'] for m in item['volumes'] if m['target']=='/etc/team/config'))
                    suffix=source.relative_to(root)
                    next(m for m in item['volumes'] if m['target']=='/etc/team/config')['source']=str(Path(daemon_root)/suffix)
                    item['labels']['org.opsforge.session06.include']=nonce
                    item.update(cap_drop=['ALL'],security_opt=['no-new-privileges'],pids_limit=32,mem_limit='32m',cpus=.25)
                (directory/'runtime-rendered.json').write_text(json.dumps(rendered))
                directory_files[directory]=['runtime-rendered.json']
            if run([*docker,'network','inspect',prefix+'-gamma-private'],ok=False).returncode==0:raise Blocked('private fixture network already exists; refuse reuse')
            for kind,names in [('network',[prefix+'-shared']),('volume',[prefix+'-'+name+'-data' for name in ('alpha','beta','gamma')])]:
                for name in names:
                    if run([*docker,kind,'inspect',name],ok=False).returncode==0:raise Blocked('owned resource name already exists; refuse reuse')
                    resources[kind+'s'][name]=None
                    run([*docker,kind,'create','--label',owner,name]);resources[kind+'s'][name]=data(kind,name).get('Id',name)
            for directory,project,expect in [(baseline,prefix+'-before',False),(candidate,prefix+'-after',True)]:
                current_directory=directory;current_project=project
                compose(directory,project,'up','--no-build','--pull','never','--detach')
                for retry in range(30):
                    try:current=observe(directory,project,expect);break
                    except (RuntimeError,AssertionError):
                        if retry==29:raise
                        time.sleep(.2)
                if not expect:
                    for name,item in current.items():
                        run([*docker,'exec',item['container_id'],'sh','-c','printf "%s" "$1" > /data/identity','sh',nonce+':'+name])
                    snapshot['before']=observe(directory,project,True)
                else:
                    snapshot['after']=current
                    assert {k:(v['image_id'],v['volume_name']) for k,v in current.items()}=={k:(v['image_id'],v['volume_name']) for k,v in snapshot['before'].items()}
                    compose(directory,project,'up','--no-build','--pull','never','--detach')
                    assert observe(directory,project,True)==current,'repeated up changed container identities'
                compose(directory,project,'down','--timeout','5')
                current_project=None;current_directory=None
            phases+=['baseline real runtime passed','include real runtime passed','image/volume identity and persisted markers passed','repeated up idempotence passed']
            status='passed'
        except Blocked as failure:status='blocked';error=str(failure)
        except Exception as failure:status='failed';error=repr(failure)
        finally:
            cleanup_errors=[]
            if current_project is not None:
                try:compose(current_directory,current_project,'down','--timeout','5')
                except Exception as failure:cleanup_errors.append(repr(failure))
            # --rm can leave a probe container if it timed out; name+owner must
            # match before removing. No global prune or broad resource delete.
            if engine_confirmed:
                try:
                    leftover=run([*docker,'ps','--all','--quiet','--filter','label='+owner],ok=False)
                    for cid in leftover.stdout.split():
                        own('container',cid);run([*docker,'container','rm','--force',cid])
                except Exception as failure:cleanup_errors.append(repr(failure))
            for kind in ('volume','network'):
                for name in resources[kind+'s']:
                    try:own(kind,name);run([*docker,kind,'rm',name])
                    except Exception as failure:cleanup_errors.append(repr(failure))
            if cleanup_errors:status='failed';error+='; cleanup: '+repr(cleanup_errors)
            report={'task_id':'question:curated-advanced-docker-020','status':status,'error':error,'phases':phases,
                    'engine_id':args.engine_id,'host':args.host,'nonce':nonce,'snapshots':snapshot,'records':records,
                    'transport_mapping':{'local_fixture_root':str(root),'daemon_fixture_volume_mountpoint':daemon_root,
                                         'method':'native docker cp into own volume, real checksum, bind probe, explicit source-prefix mapping; no claim of shared WSL /tmp'},
                    'owned_resources':resources,'cleanup_errors':cleanup_errors,'counted_complete':False,
                    'review_status':'draft runtime verifier; no author self-signature'}
    report['local_temporary_directory_removed']=not Path(temporary).exists()
    print(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False))
    return {'passed':0,'blocked':3,'failed':1}[status]


if __name__=='__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())
